# Level Up Study Hub

> Study sites for Amazon Web Services (AWS) certification exams, plus hands-on coding courses for AWS. Each certification has a quiz game, flashcards, a study guide and a full-length timed exam simulator scored on the real 100–1,000 scale. Start free with no account; each certification and each course is a subscription at $11 a month or $69 a year, and Pro unlocks everything for $199 a year. Made by Nico Tek Solutions (https://nico-tek.com/study-hub), a location intelligence and cloud software studio in Bethesda, Maryland; not affiliated with Amazon Web Services.

## Certification prep

- [AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02)](https://cloud.levelupstudyhub.com/): 65-question, 90-minute exam simulator, pass mark 700. $11 a month or $69 a year.
- [AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01)](https://ai.levelupstudyhub.com/): generative AI, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker. 65-question, 90-minute exam simulator, pass mark 700. $11 a month or $69 a year.
- [AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (SAA-C03)](https://architect.levelupstudyhub.com/): 65-question, 130-minute exam simulator, pass mark 720. $11 a month or $69 a year.
- [AWS Certified Developer – Associate (DVA-C02)](https://developer.levelupstudyhub.com/): 65-question, 130-minute exam simulator, pass mark 720. $11 a month or $69 a year.

## Coding courses

Practice in the browser (a practice terminal, real Python, a JavaScript and TypeScript editor with a pretend AWS account), then build the same thing on your own AWS account. The first tutorial of each course is free; each course is $11 a month or $69 a year, and Pro includes every course.

- [Bash for AWS](https://bash.levelupstudyhub.com/): health checks, log digging, backups to Amazon S3, one-command website deploys.
- [Python for AWS](https://python.levelupstudyhub.com/): spreadsheet reports, the AWS bill, certificate alerts, an upload pipeline with Lambda and DynamoDB, automated tests and logging.
- [JavaScript for AWS](https://js.levelupstudyhub.com/): web pages, live dashboards, a serverless contact form, a study tracker with sign-in.
- [TypeScript for AWS](https://typescript.levelupstudyhub.com/): type-safe code, a command-line tool for AWS, infrastructure as code with the Cloud Development Kit.

## Plans

- Guest preview and free account: study guides, the first quiz domain and flashcard deck of every certification, the first tutorial of every course.
- One certification or course: $11 a month or $69 a year. Renews automatically; cancel anytime.
- Pro: every certification and every coding course for $199 a year, with a 14-day free trial for first-time members (card required).
- Unlocks bought before subscriptions keep their lifetime access.
